material_findings: Model-snapshot rollback is not reliable: materialize_model_snapshot freezes files and directories to 0444/0555 before publication, but failure cleanup calls shutil.rmtree without restoring directory write permission. A rename race or post-publication verification failure can therefore leave a failed staging or published snapshot, violating the required transactional rollback and discard guarantee.
disposition: V27 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. The recirculation replication branch remains closed pending a materially new reviewed protocol identity.
